authority: docs/plans/EVENT-PROJECTED-KERNEL-GREENFIELD-REFACTORING-PLAN.md, 'Bounded prompt and context envelope' + EK-1 'Successor admission specifications' (prove every prompt/context source is classified as mandatory inline, bounded summary, content-addressed reference, bounded tool result or forbidden duplication).

classLaws.mandatory-inline: The layer travels inline in the exact admitted request. It may never disappear through silent truncation; its normalized layer digest must be present in every PromptAssemblyReceipt for attempts whose role contract requires it. Bounded by its layer budget (maxStaticTokens / maxDynamicTokens); static members that cannot fit fail installation/admission rather than being trimmed.
classLaws.bounded-summary: A bounded summary travels inline under an explicit token bound (its layer budget plus per-item bounds where declared); the full material it summarizes is available by content-addressed reference. Omission order for optional members is deterministic and recorded in the receipt.
classLaws.content-addressed-reference: Only a reference (content://... + digest) plus a bounded pointer/summary travels inline. Full material is read back in bounded chunks on demand; raw bytes are never recopied into the request.
classLaws.bounded-tool-result: A retained tool result travels inline only under maxToolResultTokens and a deterministic retention/truncation policy; overflow spills to a content-addressed reference and the receipt records the spill.
classLaws.forbidden-duplication: Duplicating this material into the request is forbidden. The enforcing boundary refuses admission (typed pre-spawn overflow) when the assembled envelope contains it; the replacement column names what travels instead.
